# Dayloop v0.15.0 — Persona 5 Royal milestone

Dayloop v0.15.0 closes the current Persona 5 Royal phase and establishes P5R
as the stable reference pack while focused work moves to Persona 3 Reload.

## P5R milestone highlights

- Complete 301-day Royal route from April 9, 2016 through February 3, 2017,
  with 1,231 stable-index tasks across separate Day, Night, and Infiltration
  sections.
- Full 23-Confidant route, 53-achievement catalog, 24 deadlines, 73 reusable
  activities, and 68 daily answer sheets.
- All 33 Mementos Requests in a dedicated tracker. A request auto-completes
  only when its exact route completion task is checked.
- Task-derived Confidant and achievement progression with corrected route dates,
  specific task wording, and compact inline spoiler-inclusive Tips.
- Final P5R Phantom presentation across Today, Calendar, Confidants, commands,
  completion feedback, widget, launcher, and startup surfaces.
- Calendar returns to the month the user browsed after opening and leaving a Day
  page; achievement scrolling pins only the two progress-counter lines.

## Pack-isolation handoff

- P5R is now documented in `docs/packs/p5r-baseline.md` and protected by a
  structural regression test.
- P3R and Metaphor work must remain pack-isolated. Shared-engine changes must
  remain generic and preserve the complete P5R behavior contract.
- A future P5R correction requires an explicit P5R change, focused validation,
  and a content-version bump when bundled content changes.

## Validation

- Android stable APK assembly and signature verification.
- App, core-pack, core-progress, and pack-tool unit tests.
- `packlint` for P5R, P3R, and Metaphor.
- Stable version metadata and P5R baseline counts pinned by tests.

Fan-made companion tool; not affiliated with or endorsed by ATLUS/SEGA.
